why: The JavaScript form of the implant is copied into the implant's own folder and run as node payload.js --agent, so the process is called node and a name comparison never sees it. A node whose script sits in a folder named as the implant is the implant running now, even after the folder itself is gone. Only the script argument is read, never the whole command line: the second node only mentions the folder in a flag, and is not it (ADR-0050).

findings.match: an implant process is running now
